Decoded by Galvor, Issue #15: Proven Message, New Look. The Refresh Rule That Got 47% More Spend

When an ad tires, most teams change everything at once: new script, new face, new first shot. Galvor's data points the other way. Keep what the ad says, change how it looks, and the new version gets a fairer start. This issue turns that into a refresh rule for every cycle of the learning loop.

Subscribe to get it every Wednesday.
notes: Outline planned 18 Nov 2026 (why now: Closes the January learning-loop theme with the most practical decision in the loop: what to carry into the next ad. Teams are briefing their first post-January-sale refreshes and planning February gifting creative.). Posted from the Galvor page. Write with Decoded → Draft with AI, then fill every [DATA NEEDED].

- New message over a familiar first shot: 16% less (Decoded #3, facts bank)
